subject: Crosslink ownership arbiter: proposed signal-handover matrix
messages:
From: Sara Patel <sara.patel@consultiva.io>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>, Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.com>
Cc: NeoLogic Partnerships <partnerships@neologic.com>
Date: Wed, 18 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Overlap in EMEA accounts — need a routing approach

Hi Rishi / Camila,

Quick note from the field: NeoLogic has started co-selling with Consultiva across three EMEA accounts where both NeoLogic and Redwood reps are actively engaged (UK-Healthcare, DACH-FinServ, Nordics-Retail). Prospect signals have crossed — we already have demo activity and a POC request. Our concern is double outreach and confusing handoffs for the customer.

Can we establish a fast, pragmatic way to route incoming signals so that the partner-invested motion vs. direct Redwood sales motion is consistent? Specifically:
- Who owns inbound demo requests when both NeoLogic and Redwood have active coverage?
- If joint opportunity, what are the criteria to escalate to a co-sell (and who signs off)?

We can share the account list and recent touchpoints — attaching a short summary (NEO_joint_proposal_summary.pdf). Happy to join a 30-min sync this week.

Thanks,
Sara
Sara Patel
Head of Alliances, Consultiva
attachments: NEO_joint_proposal_summary.pdf

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>

Date: Wed, 18 Nov 2026 10:03:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Overlap in EMEA accounts — need a routing approach

Sara — thanks for the heads up and for the attachment.

I've looped in Camila (EMEA field lead), Marissa (alliances ops), and Jonas (channel policy) to work through a lightweight routing protocol. I propose a 30-minute working session to agree on:
1) a simple handover matrix (signal -> owner) we can operationalize for the next 30 days
2) arbitration rules for contested accounts (one-page)
3) an owner for each of the three accounts you mentioned so outreach is singular and tracked in HubSpot.

Can you do 11/18 at 14:00 UTC / 06:00 PT? If not, propose two slots. I will prepare an initial matrix (handover_matrix_v1.xlsx) as a starting point and share ahead of the call.

Best,
Rishi
Rishi Malhotra
Head of Partnerships — Redwood Inference

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>, Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.com>, Sara Patel <sara.patel@consultiva.io>
Cc: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 18 Nov 2026 13:12:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Overlap in EMEA accounts — need a routing approach (handover v1)

All — attaching the first pass: handover_matrix_v1.xlsx. High-level proposal (summary):

- Signal precedence (ordered): existing joint POC > partner-led demo with partner advocate > inbound web lead with no partner link.
- Ownership rules:
  * If partner-sourced and partner engagement started > partner owns initial demo and qualification (owner = partner rep).
  * If Redwood-sourced and partner only introduced later, Redwood owns the sales cycle unless partner brings >20% of pipeline value or supports technical integration requiring partner co-ownership.
- Arbitration:
  * For contested accounts, a single-step arbiter is the Partnerships Ops lead (Marissa) — decision window: 48 hours.
  * If policy edge-case, escalate to Rishi for final call.

Operational items included in the workbook: account tags to set in HubSpot, field for "signal provenance", and an "arbiter decision" column.

Questions for Sara: can you confirm the date of the partner-sourced demo for the UK-Healthcare account and the technical owner from NeoLogic? If we have those two items, we can assign owners on the call.

Marissa
Marissa Cole
Director, Partnerships Operations — Redwood Inference
attachments: handover_matrix_v1.xlsx

From: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.com>

Date: Wed, 18 Nov 2026 14:02:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Overlap in EMEA accounts — need a routing approach (pilot ask)

Thanks Marissa — +1 on rapid arbitration. A few tweaks I recommend before we lock:

- Pilot approach: run the handover matrix as a 2-week pilot for the three accounts Sara flagged. Track outcomes (time-to-first-response, duplicate outreach count, deal state drift).
- Co-sell criteria tweak: require partner technical validation step for co-ownership when integration is >1 week of engineering work.
- Communication: add an automated Slack alert into #partners-ops for contested signals so Sales + Partner PMs see the dispute.

Action: Sara — please confirm the demo timestamps and NeoLogic technical owner. Marissa — if you can, add the pilot tracking columns to handover_matrix_v1.xlsx and drop a Drive link. I'll prepare a short internal one-pager we can share with NeoLogic post-call.

-Camila
Camila Reyes
EMEA Field Lead — Redwood Inference

Appreciate the quick work, team. Summary and decisions from our alignment:

1) Pilot approved: 2-week pilot (11/20–12/04) for the three flagged accounts. Marissa will own ops and arbitration; Camila will own the field communications and internal enablement; Sara will align NeoLogic technical owner and confirm partner-sourced demo dates.
2) Arbitration: Partnerships Ops (Marissa) is the 48-hour arbiter. If unresolved, Rishi makes final call.
3) Matrix & tracking: Marissa to publish updated handover_matrix_v1.xlsx to Drive with pilot-tracking columns and Slack alert integration by 11/19 EOD. Link: https://drive.google.com/open?id=1MatrixProposal
4) HubSpot: Camila to add "signal_provenance" and "arbiter_decision" fields to the account cards for the three accounts. HubSpot link: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/123456/company/98765

Meeting: 30-min sync scheduled 11/20 09:00 UTC (invite sent).

Owners & next steps:
- Marissa: update workbook, enable Slack alert, publish link (due 11/19 EOD)
- Camila: HubSpot fields + one-pager for NeoLogic (due 11/20 before sync)
- Sara: confirm NeoLogic tech owner + demo timestamps (due 11/19 EOD)
- Rishi: if arbiter is needed, I will step in.

Let's keep this lightweight — objective is clear ownership and fewer customer touch duplications. Thanks all.

Rishi
